top_signals.title: New UN data: China widens lead in liner-shipping connectivity
top_signals.summary:
China pressed its dominance in shipping connectivity while country-level gains and losses became increasingly uneven in the third quarter, a UN report finds.

The post New UN data: China widens lead in liner-shipping connectivity appeared first on FreightWaves.

top_signals.title: US Yields Erases EM Bond Gains
top_signals.summary:
Tara Hariharan, Co-CIO with NWI Management, joins Emily Graffeo on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Dollar debt from countries in the emerging world has turned negative for the year, after having outperformed as turmoil sent yields on US Treasuries to the highest in nearly two decades.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: See 'Skittishness' Around Credit: Annie Seelaus
top_signals.summary:
Annie Seelaus, CEO of R. Seelaus, and John Lloyd, global head of multi-sector and corporate credit at Janus Henderson, join Emily Graffeo on "Bloomberg Real Yield." The spread on the riskiest US corporate bonds has jumped above 1,000 basis points over Treasuries for the first time since the regional banking crisis in 2023. That level of risk premium typically implies high probability of default, restructuring or loss.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: Brazil Meat Firm Pauses Bond-Sale Plan as Funding Costs Soar
top_signals.summary: MBRF Global Foods Co. SA has decided to hold off on a potential junk-debt offering as a global bond selloff has sent borrowing costs soaring.

top_signals.title: Pritzker Family Weighs Over $1 Billion Sale of Propane Business
top_signals.summary: Energy Distribution Partners, a privately-held propane and light fuels distributor backed by Pritzker Private Capital, is exploring a sale that could value the company at more than $1 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
